A '''swamp planet''' served as home to an [[Unidentified elite assassin|elite assassin]] and his [[Assassin's base|base]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The base was infiltrated by a mercenary group led by a [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist|wealthy industrialist]], intending to hire the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin's]] services to kill [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
